opening: My vision has been getting worse.
It has been slowly declining ever since my cataract surgery two years ago.
Light bothers both of my eyes.
I had cataract surgery two years ago.
I've had open-angle glaucoma for 25 years.
For the last seven years my glaucoma has been treated with brimonidine 0.1% drops, twice a day in both eyes.
